subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Lethal
solution:
The correct answer is **Fatal.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lethal:** that can cause death or great damage.
 
• **Fatal: **causing or ending in death.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate synonym for **'****Lethal'** is **'****Fatal'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Slothful:** Lazy.
 
• **Beneficial:** having a good or useful effect.
 
• **Lazy:** moving slowly or without much energy.
